items.title: Sadie Goodson Interview, 1984-12-12
items.q: Her name was Rachel Goodson, my grandmother, my father's mother.

ctx.x: Was there a band or were you just playing the piano?

No, just played the piano by yourself. Wasn't no band. They would sing on the stage at that time. Let me lower the mic a little, Sadie, if I can do that. Yeah, okay. You know it's not picking up too well. It picks me up fine, but then I talk too much and too loud. Yeah. By the way, you ever see one of those? A tie pin like that? No, I never saw one like that. I never saw one. You know what that is? It looks like a train, doesn't it? Yeah, it's a diesel engine. That's what I thought it was. Yeah. My daddy was a…
Do you know what he did, what kind of business he did or what he did for me? My grandfather? You know what? He made gardens, he loved gardens. Planked all kinds of vegetables.
